title: Mediterranean Lemon Herb Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon with cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, capers, and fresh dill.
instructions: Pat salmon fillets dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a stainless steel skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear salmon skin-side up for 4 minutes, flip carefully, and scatter cherry tomatoes and olives around the fillets.
Cook for another 4-5 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with fresh dill and serve warm with lemon slices.

title: Crispy Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Golden cubes of extra-firm tofu tossed with snap peas, bell peppers, and savory sesame ginger sauce.
instructions: Toss cubed tofu with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet; fry tofu for 6-8 minutes until crisp and golden on all sides, then remove.
Add vegetables to the pan and stir-fry over high heat for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, and minced ginger; pour into skillet with tofu and toss until glossy.
